description: Clients (design §5.1-§5.3, D4, D5, D7): packages/core LINK_AADHAAR_CARD_MUTATION + deprecated REVEAL_* + audit label; web PersonDialog opt-in card upload under the safe name 'Aadhaar card.<ext>' then linkAadhaarCard, last-4 display via formatAadhaarMask with tabular-nums, read-from-card summary with DD/MM/YYYY; Groups/GroupDetail mask normalization; sealed e2e spec 07; Expo reveal/copy removal; iOS DocSpineTests synthetic fixture (test data only). Plan items 9-12. Depends on FEAT-001 only for the GraphQL mutation name/arguments (linkAadhaarCard(candidateId, nodeId, versionId): Boolean!).
steps: Plan item 9 — packages/core/src/api/operations.ts: add export const LINK_AADHAAR_CARD_MUTATION = `mutation($candidateId:String!,$nodeId:String!,$versionId:String!){ linkAadhaarCard(candidateId:$candidateId,nodeId:$nodeId,versionId:$versionId) }`; add /** @deprecated Reveal is retired on the server; only the last 4 digits are kept for display. */ on REVEAL_AADHAAR_MUTATION and REVEAL_MY_AADHAAR_MUTATION. Export the new constant from packages/core/src/index.ts. packages/core/src/format/audit.ts: label link_aadhaar_card: 'Kept an Aadhaar card'; isSecurityAction includes it; extend packages/core/src/format/audit.test.ts.

Plan item 10 — apps/web/src/pages/families/PersonDialog.tsx: add exported pure cardName(mime) (lowercase; application/pdf->pdf, image/jpeg|image/jpg->jpg, image/png->png, image/heic->heic, image/heif->heif, image/webp->webp, else bin; returns 'Aadhaar card.<ext>'); in handleAadhaar upload only when retainAadhaarCard AND the read returned aadhaarCandidateId, as new File([file], cardName(file.type), {type: file.type}) to the existing /api/gateway/storage/files?appId=pattadar&onConflict=duplicate; from the JSON node use id and currentVersionId to call gql(LINK_AADHAAR_CARD_MUTATION, {candidateId, nodeId, versionId}) (gql from ../../api/client); messages: upload fail -> existing warning; link fail -> 'The card was saved to My Drive but could not be linked to this reading'; ticked but no candidate -> 'No Aadhaar number was read, so the card was not kept' and no upload. Render every mask (success Alert ~368, helper text ~637) as formatAadhaarMask(aadhaarMasked) from @pattadar/core inside <Box component="span" sx={{ fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}>. Add a read-only 'Read from the card' summary (Name, Date of birth via ddmmyyyy() from apps/web/src/w360/ui.tsx, Gender, Aadhaar XXXX XXXX 1234) using the existing Typography/Box (no new font, weight, or page-local component). Manual Aadhaar field unchanged. Add a unit test for cardName (bun test, co-located e.g. apps/web/src/pages/families/cardName.test.ts or PersonDialog.test.ts following existing apps/web test style).

Plan item 10 (cont.) — apps/web/src/w360/pages/Groups.tsx (~832) and apps/web/src/pages/families/GroupDetail.tsx (~527): render formatAadhaarMask(m.aadhaarMasked) || '—' (keep existing mono/tabular styling).

Plan item 10 (cont.) — tests/e2e-app/specs/07-record-people.spec.ts (~1738-1795): storage route answers { id: 'file-aadhaar', currentVersionId: 'ver-aadhaar' }; route the linkAadhaarCard GraphQL operation through the world fixture; unticked -> zero storage/files calls; ticked -> one upload whose multipart filename is 'Aadhaar card.<ext>' (assert from the request body) followed by one linkAadhaarCard call with the candidate/node/version ids; success text shows 'XXXX XXXX 9012'; summary DOB shows 14/03/1985; page text has no 12-digit run. Update the 'Read securely as' assertion to the new format. Touch specs 19/01 only if their mask assertions break.

Plan item 11 — Expo: apps/mobile/src/data/hooks.ts remove REVEAL_AADHAAR_MUTATION/REVEAL_MY_AADHAAR_MUTATION imports, revealAadhaar from useMemberActions (~664-673) and reveal from useMyAadhaar (~702); apps/mobile/src/app/account.tsx remove the copy IconButton (~229-240) and the secureReveal import (mask still via formatAadhaarMask); apps/mobile/src/app/add-member.tsx remove the copy button (~477-490), make the stored-row Pressable (~453-468) only setReplacingAadhaar(true) with an empty field, accessibility label 'Replace the Aadhaar number', caption 'Aadhaar on record · tap to replace', remove the secureReveal import, normalize the mask at ~524 with formatAadhaarMask; delete apps/mobile/src/lib/secureReveal.ts.

Plan item 12 — apps/ios/PattadarKit/Tests/PattadarKitTests/DocSpineTests.swift (~192-260): replace fixture values per design §5.3 table (distinct Aadhaar runs -> 1234 1234 1234 / 5678 5678 5678 / 4321 4321 4321 incl. unbroken forms, mask expectations to matching last 4, enrolment 1111/22222/33333, phone 9000000000, PIN 500001, DOB 01/01/1990 / 1990-01-01 / 'DOB 1 January 1990', name 'Test Person', documentNo 'XXXX XXXX 1234', comments 'A synthetic e-Aadhaar text layer' / 'A synthetic Aadhaar upload'). Never print the old values (use the editor, not echo/grep output of values). No iOS source change.

Every scripts/*-tests.ts passes except the pre-existing typography TY-5 failure in apps/university/src/styles.css; icon-guard and ux-guards exit 0; parity-check reports no new errors
Spec 07 Aadhaar tests pass when a :5180 dev server is available (else recorded NOT RUN with reason)

findings:

3) for s in scripts/*-tests.ts -> all ok except typography-tests.ts TY-5 (apps/university/src/styles.css:1488/1520/1538 font-weight 800 = PRE-EXISTING baseline); shared-components-tests ok; icon-guard exit 0 (ICON GUARD PASSES); ux-guards exit 0 (UX GUARDS PASS).
4) bun run scripts/parity-check.ts -> PARITY DRIFT 2 errors, both [twins]: (a) packages/core/src/land/landcalc.ts (PRE-EXISTING, another session's dirty file); (b) packages/core/src/api/operations.ts changed without apps/ios/PattadarKit/Sources/PattadarKit/Networking/Queries.swift.    Extra (not required): full spec 07 -> 83 passed / 16 failed; all 16 are in the W360 record 'hanger'/'renaming'/'refresh' sections (e.g. getByText('Sy 214/2 · Katragunta') not found on the record header), none in the legacy PersonDialog section; specs 01/19 also show failures ('The screen logged errors' 400 console errors, seeded job counts). These screens are untouched by FEAT-003 and overlap other sessions' dirty W360 files; recorded as unrelated, not investigated further. Specs 19/01 mask assertions needed no change.
6) cd apps/ios/PattadarKit && swift test --filter DocSpineTests -> 20 tests passed (Swift 6.4). First run failed one assertion: review.first?.text.contains(<first group>) == false can no longer distinguish masked from open text because the synthetic (\d{4})\1\1 number repeats its last 4; replaced with contains('5678 5678') == false plus contains('×××× ×××× 5678') == true (same intent: no open number in the caveat).
7) grep -rn 'reveal\(My\|Member\)Aadhaar\|secureReveal\|REVEAL_' apps/mobile/src -> empty.

CHANGES:
- packages/core: LINK_AADHAAR_CARD_MUTATION (exact §5.1 string) in api/operations.ts + exported from index.ts; @deprecated JSDoc on REVEAL_AADHAAR_MUTATION and REVEAL_MY_AADHAAR_MUTATION; format/audit.ts label link_aadhaar_card 'Kept an Aadhaar card' and isSecurityAction includes it; audit.test.ts case.
- apps/web PersonDialog.tsx: exported pure cardName(mime) (fixed table, lowercased, else bin); kept card uploaded only when ticked AND the read returned aadhaarCandidateId, as new File([file], cardName(file.type), {type}) to /api/gateway/storage/files?appId=pattadar&onConflict=duplicate, then gql(LINK_AADHAAR_CARD_MUTATION, {candidateId, nodeId: id, versionId: currentVersionId}); messages: upload fail -> existing warning, link fail (or response without id/currentVersionId) -> 'The card was saved to My Drive but could not be linked to this reading', ticked without candidate -> 'No Aadhaar number was read, so the card was not kept' with no upload. A warning is now the ONLY toast for that read (previously the success toast fired right after and replaced it). Success Alert and helper text render formatAadhaarMask in <Box component="span" sx={{fontVariantNumeric:'tabular-nums'}}> (small MaskedAadhaar helper in the same file); read-only 'Read from the card' summary (role=group, aria-label) with Name, Date of birth via ddmmyyyy() from w360/ui.tsx, Gender, Aadhaar mask, using existing Box/Typography only (no new font/weight). Manual Aadhaar field unchanged.
- apps/web Groups.tsx (~832) and GroupDetail.tsx (~527): formatAadhaarMask(m.aadhaarMasked) || '—'.
- tests/e2e-app/specs/07-record-people.spec.ts: legacyFamilies() falls back to the world for linkAadhaarCard (answered as world.set('root.linkAadhaarCard', …)); main Aadhaar test: storage answers {id:'file-aadhaar', currentVersionId:'ver-aadhaar'}, unticked -> 0 storage/files and 0 link calls, 'Read securely as XXXX XXXX 9012.', summary shows Lakshmi Devi / 14/03/1985 / XXXX XXXX 9012; ticked -> 1 upload whose multipart body has filename="Aadhaar card.pdf" (not the picked name), then exactly 1 linkAadhaarCard with {candidateId:'candidate-opaque', nodeId:'file-aadhaar', versionId:'ver-aadhaar'} after the upload; body innerText has no 12-digit run. Two new tests: link refused -> 'saved to My Drive but could not be linked' (1 upload, 1 link); ticked read with no number -> 'No Aadhaar number was read, so the card was not kept', 0 uploads, 0 links.
- apps/mobile: hooks.ts drops REVEAL_* imports, revealAadhaar (useMemberActions) and reveal (useMyAadhaar); account.tsx drops the Copy button and secureReveal import (stored Aadhaar row has no right action; mask still via formatAadhaarMask; 'Add' scan button unchanged when none stored); add-member.tsx drops the Copy button and secureReveal import, stored-row Pressable now only clears the field and sets replacing (label 'Replace the Aadhaar number', caption 'Aadhaar on record · tap to replace'), helper mask via formatAadhaarMask; apps/mobile/src/lib/secureReveal.ts deleted (worktree only; index left untouched). NOTE: expo-local-authentication is now unused in apps/mobile/src but remains in package.json/app.json plugins (dependency removal is out of scope; follow-up via dependency-change).
- apps/ios DocSpineTests.swift (test data only, lines ~192-266): two distinct Aadhaar runs -> 1234 1234 1234 / 5678 5678 5678 (spaced and unbroken), mask expectations to matching last 4, documentNo 'XXXX XXXX 1234', enrolment 1111/22222/33333, phone 9000000000, PIN 500001, DOB 01/01/1990 / 1990-01-01 / 'DOB 1 January 1990', name 'Test Person', comments 'A synthetic e-Aadhaar text layer' / 'A synthetic Aadhaar upload'. Old values were never printed (edits via in-place script; only line numbers/counts output). Only two distinct runs existed, so 4321 4321 4321 was not needed. The holder name still appears elsewhere in the file outside the §5.3 range (lines ~13-73) and one comment at ~219 still says "founder's own spine table" — left unchanged as out of the specified range; FEAT-004's digit guard does not cover names.

GOVERNANCE: docs -> none here (FEAT-004 owns docs/parity notes); architecture -> no new entrypoint, web now calls the existing GraphQL linkAadhaarCard after the existing storage upload; security/privacy -> card filed under a fixed safe name (original filename never sent), only masks rendered, Expo reveal/copy removed; testing -> above; cleanup -> dev server stopped, /tmp logs removed; tests/e2e-app/test-results (gitignored Playwright output, overwritten each run) left in place.
